estimation_reasoning_summary: The task BccTask_StabilityRequest_20ms executes a single loop with exactly 20 iterations. In each iteration, it performs an array read (g_wheel_capture[index]), calls the helper function ApplyActuatorGain (which executes a 32-bit integer multiplication and division by 256), accumulates the correction, and applies conditional bounds checks. Under GCC -O0 optimization on ARM Cortex-M4F (48MHz), unoptimized stack frame overhead per function call adds ~20 cycles, loop overhead adds ~10 cycles, and the body takes ~40 cycles, resulting in ~70-72 cycles per iteration (~1440 nominal cycles total). This is scaled relative to AppTask_TorqueCoordination_20ms which takes ~144 cycles/iteration due to a more complex torque interpolation helper.

All loop bounds are strictly constant (20 iterations)
